findings: Secondary translation unit pruning occurs after all translation units have parsed, so it cannot remove their accumulated parsing state early.
A public pointer-only struct whose original layout has size16 becomes an incomplete IL type and an empty generated C# public struct.
A focused fixture still executes in native/JIT builds, demonstrating why execution-only checks are insufficient for this option.
decision: Do not enable this as a transparent DuckDB memory fallback. Public layout preservation and parsing memory remain unresolved.
